newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Second Chance offers 14.25 million shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Second Chance offers 14.25 million shares in IPO.

text.p: Second Chance Enterprises Ltd, a gold and fashion retailer, said on Thursday it was offering 14.25 million shares to the public at a price of S$0.30 each in an initial public offering (IPO) for a listing on Singapore's second-board SESDAQ.
Second Chance also said in a statement it would offer 4.75 million shares by placement at the same price.
The company expects to raise S$5.25 million from the offering, of which it will use S$4.7 million to expand its gold and jewellery business in Singapore, and the rest for working capital.
The offer will close on January 22. Trading will start on a when-issued basis on January 24. DBS Bank is the manager, underwriter and placement agent for the share offer.
